name: code-maps
description: Maps of a codebase as navigable HTML pages, built from what the code compiles to and does rather than from reading it. Ships java-diagrams: class and package diagrams for a Java project, read from bytecode, cross-checked against jdeps, every view verified against the extracted graph and bounded so it stays readable. architecture-map: the same graph at the three granularities a review needs — a layered component picture with external systems, a curated class map with the members that matter, and the full detail with packages that open and close — as single-file pages that are also the editor, where a person writes membership and words and every arrow between code boxes is aggregated from bytecode and accounted for. And execution-trace: a run trace that follows one execution from the command line to its last effect, step by step like a debugger, redrawn through layers (process, code, state, data, disk), with excerpts cut from the source at build time, call arrows read from bytecode and classes filtered by a measured class-load log.
